blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with three bounded implementation families: restore readable authored-arena traversal and complete run lifecycle, replace text-stacked upgrade choices with truthful input-complete visual hierarchy, and isolate dense-profile setup/sampling for host qualification.

diagnosis.root_cause: The shipped cemetery composition is over-dominated and underexposed, with partial Warden visibility caused by landmark/ground occlusion. The candidate also needs a complete ordinary title-to-result/retry contract, decision-focused upgrade presentation, and host-recappable dense-run instrumentation.

stop_conditions: Do not replace the preserved authored cemetery package or retained component assets unless Tester records package-level incompatibility.
Do not claim issue closure, phase-gate passage, or host recapture completion; those belong to Tester and GameLoop Runtime.
Keep tester-only setup actions unavailable in release exports and stop after the three bounded task families.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior camera transform tuning: restore authoritative world, collision, navigation, and lifecycle bindings first; repair HUD transaction/presentation separately; isolate dense qualification hooks from shipped gameplay.

code: Run Godot import/project checks and static validation for all changed scripts/scenes; preserve native_godot_project and host_godot_boot baselines.
Exercise upgrade draft transaction tests for one-draft-per-threshold, overflow preservation, idempotent apply, truthful deltas, focus navigation, and pause ownership.
Exercise tester dense setup/advance/reset guards, receipt generation, 32-enemy cap reachability, and release-export exclusion.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture camera movement/dash, survivor HUD presentation, complete ordinary run/result/retry, and dense 32-enemy performance in that order.

Capture runtime state and distributed screenshots for spawn, landmark approach/contact/departure, perimeter, draft focus/selection, applied build, result, Retry, and three distinct successful build routes where available.
Use the same-framing movement replay to verify collision, disappearance/occlusion, boundary/perimeter, external depth, and full player readability; Tester owns verdicts and issue closure.
visual: Compare shipped high-angle gameplay against the bound Mournlight reference for warm lantern/cool moonlight hierarchy, readable silhouettes, external depth, escape lanes, and native cemetery composition.
Inspect upgrade draft at native, fullscreen, windowed, and supported UI scales for silhouettes, compact icons, truthful current-to-new deltas, restrained copy, and complete focus states.
Inspect result/Retry and dense-profile runs for clipped controls, debug presentation, stale overlays, or unintended HUD/visual regressions.

done_when: The arena has larger traversable scale or an explicit expand result, with a coherent external world/external depth beyond the playable perimeter.
A central building or landmark remains visible and stable during ordinary movement/movement replay, and its collision prevents player and enemies from passing through.
No landmark disappearance or camera occlusion drift occurs before approach, at near contact, or after departure; the boundary/perimeter aligns with collision and navigation.
Spawn, critical-route, and cardinal/landmark views keep the Warden fully readable, with no proxy-floor or visible-void exposure and at least one useful escape lane.
Dash has visible anticipation/onset/recovery, bounded cooldown and invulnerability, and pause/resume or retry cannot leave contradictory velocity, timers, or immunity.

A normal seven-to-ten-minute route can traverse five escalating waves, reach the Bellkeeper final wave, and produce victory or failure, a result screen with required statistics, and a clean Retry/title transition without stale actors, UI, audio, or pause state.
Host can recapture spatial bounds, collision/occlusion state, lifecycle state, and same-framing movement replay evidence.
tasks.instructions: Repair the world/camera integration around the existing authored cemetery package. Rebase player spawn, objective anchors, collision, navigation, camera framing, and perimeter onto native streets and landmark geometry; expand the traversable space and preserve external world depth. Remove or minimize unrelated proxy/support clutter. Ensure the central building/landmark has authoritative collision, remains visible through ordinary movement, and never disappears at an occlusion threshold; use bounded transparency or selective facade/roof handling if needed. Reconcile dash ownership, pause/reset, victory/failure, result, and Retry/title transitions through the authoritative run controller. Do not replace the authored map or perform host evidence collection.
tasks.title: Restore authored arena scale, collision, camera readability, and complete run lifecycle

done_when: Each upgrade/weapon choice leads with an authored silhouette or recognizable icon and compact stat icons rather than a text stack.
Every choice shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas; CURRENT never contains NEW or LOCKED placeholders.
Unchanged, zero, unrelated, and exhaustive stat rows are omitted; names and consequence copy remain subordinate to the visual hierarchy.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, selected, confirm, and cancel states are visibly distinct without changing card dimensions.

Held confirm is debounced: one threshold opens one draft, one selection applies exactly once, overflow XP is preserved, authoritative build/HUD state updates before gameplay resumes, and gameplay clocks remain paused during the draft.
Resulting choices preserve distinguishable focused bolts, close-range sweeps, and orbiting area-control build identities rather than renamed copies.
